description: This dataset describes hourly electricity consumption for one two-storey house in Houston, Texas, with daily local weather and weekday, weekend, vacation and COVID-lockdown labels. Sri Polu attributes the electricity observations to TriEagle Energy and the weather to Weather Underground. For demand forecasting, the provider proposes predicting household power usage from dates and weather, and classifying operating-context labels. Measurements are stated in kWh. Weather variables include temperature, dew point, humidity, wind, pressure and precipitation. Although the title says three years and introductory text runs to August 2020, the explicit file note gives electricity coverage from1 June2016 to7 July 2020 and weather through30 August 2020. The provider warns of inconsistent date formats. CSV is identified for the electricity file; weather internal format is not established. Reuse licence, cost and payload restrictions remain unknown. Native Kaggle metadata supplies the description and access route. Related resources: no equivalent active household record was found; cited PJM examples are inspiration, not the source of these household observations. No data file was obtained.
